muk/obligations@0.1
# declaration: sum_of_elementwise_differences
# syntax: obl <id> |- <lhs> === <rhs> :: <rule> from=[...] ctx=[...]
# NOTHING HERE IS DISCHARGED. This file states WHAT must be proved.

obl B1   |- (eltsub nil nil) === nil
        :: def_elem_nil from=[] ctx=[]
obl B2   |- (sum (eltsub nil nil)) === (sum nil)
        :: sum_cong from=[B1] ctx=[]
obl B3   |- (sum nil) === zero
        :: def_sum_nil from=[] ctx=[]
obl B4   |- (sum (eltsub nil nil)) === zero
        :: trans from=[B2,B3] ctx=[]
obl B5   |- (sum nil) === zero
        :: def_sum_nil from=[] ctx=[]
obl B6   |- (sum nil) === zero
        :: def_sum_nil from=[] ctx=[]
obl B7   |- (sub (sum nil) (sum nil)) === (sub zero zero)
        :: sub_cong from=[B5,B6] ctx=[]
obl B8   |- zero === (sub zero zero)
        :: ax_abgrp from=[] ctx=[]
obl B9   |- (sub zero zero) === (sub (sum nil) (sum nil))
        :: sym from=[B7] ctx=[]
obl B10  |- zero === (sub (sum nil) (sum nil))
        :: trans from=[B8,B9] ctx=[]
obl B11  |- (sum (eltsub nil nil)) === (sub (sum nil) (sum nil))
        :: trans from=[B4,B10] ctx=[]
obl S1   |- (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys)) === (cons (sub x y) (eltsub xs ys))
        :: def_elem_cons from=[] ctx=[]
obl S2   |- (sum (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys))) === (sum (cons (sub x y) (eltsub xs ys)))
        :: sum_cong from=[S1] ctx=[]
obl S3   |- (sum (cons (sub x y) (eltsub xs ys))) === (add (sub x y) (sum (eltsub xs ys)))
        :: def_sum_cons from=[] ctx=[]
obl S4   |- (sum (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys))) === (add (sub x y) (sum (eltsub xs ys)))
        :: trans from=[S2,S3] ctx=[]
obl S5   |- (sub x y) === (sub x y)
        :: refl from=[] ctx=[]
obl S6   |- (sum (eltsub xs ys)) === (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))
        :: assume from=[] ctx=[]
obl S7   |- (add (sub x y) (sum (eltsub xs ys))) === (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys)))
        :: add_cong from=[S5,S6] ctx=[]
obl S8   |- (sum (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys))) === (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys)))
        :: trans from=[S4,S7] ctx=[]
obl S9   |- (sum (cons x xs)) === (add x (sum xs))
        :: def_sum_cons from=[] ctx=[]
obl S10  |- (sum (cons y ys)) === (add y (sum ys))
        :: def_sum_cons from=[] ctx=[]
obl S11  |- (sub (sum (cons x xs)) (sum (cons y ys))) === (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys)))
        :: sub_cong from=[S9,S10] ctx=[]
obl S12  |- (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))) === (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys)))
        :: ax_abgrp from=[] ctx=[]
obl S13  |- (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys))) === (sub (sum (cons x xs)) (sum (cons y ys)))
        :: sym from=[S11] ctx=[]
obl S14  |- (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))) === (sub (sum (cons x xs)) (sum (cons y ys)))
        :: trans from=[S12,S13] ctx=[]
obl S15  |- (sum (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys))) === (sub (sum (cons x xs)) (sum (cons y ys)))
        :: trans from=[S8,S14] ctx=[]
obl F1   |- (sum (eltsub (cons x xs) (cons y ys))) === (sub (sum (cons x xs)) (sum (cons y ys)))
        :: induct from=[B11,S15] ctx=[]

side sc_B1   :: goal must be the instance of `def_elem_nil` named by its parameters   [of=B1]
side sc_B2   :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=B2]
side sc_B3   :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_nil` named by its parameters   [of=B3]
side sc_B4   :: middle term must match: (sum nil) == (sum nil)   [of=B4]
side sc_B5   :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_nil` named by its parameters   [of=B5]
side sc_B6   :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_nil` named by its parameters   [of=B6]
side sc_B7   :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=B7]
side sc_B8   :: normal forms must coincide (free abelian group, atoms = x,y,sum)    [of=B8]
side sc_B9   :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=B9]
side sc_B10  :: middle term must match: (sub zero zero) == (sub zero zero)   [of=B10]
side sc_B11  :: middle term must match: zero == zero   [of=B11]
side sc_S1   :: goal must be the instance of `def_elem_cons` named by its parameters   [of=S1]
side sc_S2   :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=S2]
side sc_S3   :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_cons` named by its parameters   [of=S3]
side sc_S4   :: middle term must match: (sum (cons (sub x y) (eltsub xs ys))) == (sum (cons (sub x y) (eltsub xs ys)))   [of=S4]
side sc_S5   :: both sides must be the identical term   [of=S5]
side sc_S6   :: context gains exactly: (sum (eltsub xs ys)) === (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))   [of=S6]
side sc_S7   :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=S7]
side sc_S8   :: middle term must match: (add (sub x y) (sum (eltsub xs ys))) == (add (sub x y) (sum (eltsub xs ys)))   [of=S8]
side sc_S9   :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_cons` named by its parameters   [of=S9]
side sc_S10  :: goal must be the instance of `def_sum_cons` named by its parameters   [of=S10]
side sc_S11  :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=S11]
side sc_S12  :: normal forms must coincide (free abelian group, atoms = x,y,sum)    [of=S12]
side sc_S13  :: goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise   [of=S13]
side sc_S14  :: middle term must match: (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys))) == (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys)))   [of=S14]
side sc_S15  :: middle term must match: (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))) == (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys)))   [of=S15]
side sc_F1a  :: premise B11 must carry empty context   [of=F1]
side sc_F1b  :: premise S15 context must be EXACTLY { IH }   [of=F1]
side sc_F1c  :: base shape = (eltsub nil nil) / (sum nil - sum nil)   [of=F1]
side sc_F1d  :: step shape = (eltsub cons cons) / (sum cons - sum cons)   [of=F1]

meta M1  :: typing     : `eltsub` is defined only on pairs in the SAME vector(R); totality on equal lengths is a typing fact, not a kernel goal
meta M2  :: typing     : `cons` preserves the carrier: R x vector(R) -> vector(R), so shared length is preserved
meta M3  :: typing     : the goal's premise `len(a) = len(b)` is absorbed by both a,b : vector(R) of the same n
meta M4  :: modeling   : rows lacking a real in either column are excluded when n is chosen; not a kernel goal
meta M5  :: alternative : FOR UNTYPED LISTS the length premise is NOT absorbed; add goals: len(eltsub(a,b)) = len(a); len(cons(x,xs)) = 1 + len(xs); len(nil) = 0

# ---- OPTIONAL refinement, discharges S12 without the ax_abgrp oracle ----
obl R1   |- (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys))) === (add (add x (sum xs)) (sub zero (add y (sum ys)))) :: def_sub   [alt-for=S12]
obl R2   |- (sub zero (add y (sum ys))) === (add (sub zero y) (sub zero (sum ys))) :: ax_abgrp   [alt-for=S12]
obl R3   |- (sub x y) === (add x (sub zero y)) :: def_sub   [alt-for=S12]
obl R4   |- (sub (sum xs) (sum ys)) === (add (sum xs) (sub zero (sum ys))) :: def_sub   [alt-for=S12]
obl R5   |- (add (add x (sub zero y)) (add (sum xs) (sub zero (sum ys)))) === (add (add x (sum xs)) (add (sub zero y) (sub zero (sum ys)))) :: ax_abgrp   [alt-for=S12]
obl R6   |- (add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))) === (sub (add x (sum xs)) (add y (sum ys))) :: trans   [alt-for=S12]

goal |- forall a b : vector(R), len(a) = len(b) => sum(eltsub(a,b)) = sum(a) - sum(b)      [via=F1]
